name: Hawk Performance LTS Brake Pads; Front Pair (07-18 Silverado 1500)

visible.author: FosFoster
visible.title: Most overrated pads on the market
visible.body: These pads i had for three months and switched them out because the squeak like no other. Complete trash and to pay over 350 for front and back is even worse. Garbage.
visible.product: Hawk Performance LTS Brake Pads; Front Pair (15-20 F-150)

visible.author: Damien
visible.title: Poor performance
visible.body: Unfortunately I did not have a good experience with these pads. I'm running 35 inch tires on a 2019 Silverado. My OEM pads stopped my truck extremely well but started making noise at around 40k miles so I decided to try to improve my braking performance with the Hawk LTS pads. My mechanic followed the bed in procedure and I also followed the bed in procedure. I also gave the pads 1k miles to see if I felt an improvement, unfortunately these pads decreased my stopping power by about 30%. I'm going back to the OEM pads. I've seen a lot of good reviews with these pads which is why I chose them but I would not recommend them for the 2019-2025 Silverado.

visible.author: PeteinOrlando
visible.title: Much improved from factory brakes
visible.body: I can not begin to tell you the night and day difference these brakes have made on my 2016 F-150. My factory pads were glazed over after i hit the brakes at highway speed one time. These pads have a minor squeak in bumper to bumper traffic but my truck stops on a dime now! I recommend these pads to every truck owner out there. I replace my pads all the way around and will purchase these again down the road as needed.
visible.product: Hawk Performance LTS Brake Pads; Rear Pair (12-20 F-150)

visible.author: BLACKTOP
visible.title: Hawk LTS Front Brake pads on 2010 F150
visible.body: I recently installed the Hawk LTS Front brake pads on my 201F150 Crew Cab. 15k miles ago I had installed EBC Green stuff pads and they were already at their wear limits with only 2 short tows and mostly daily driver use in 2 years. Also the brake dust from them was incredible and required harsher chemicals to get them fully clean. I changed them out for the Hawk pads and I have been seen similar braking performance, far less brake dust and no noise. The EBCs have slightly better bite during initial braking but I believe they are a softer compound like the Hawk HPS pads and I wanted something that was going to last me longer this go around. When the time comes to replace the rear pads, I will also use the Hawk LTS pads.
